new_learnings.text: Semiconductor sector correction (费城半导体-11.38% in 2 days, A-shares -10%+ from peak) correctly triggers h019 hard-no-buy, eliminating 12/31 candidates. Rule working as designed.
new_learnings.mechanism: Global semiconductor profit-taking after +326% 1yr run creates sector-wide gravity that overwhelms individual stock strength.

new_learnings.text: Hot sector + MA violation = still no-buy. Both healthcare candidates (凯莱英, 荣昌生物) in TOP 5 sectors fail dist_ma20 >12%. h027 validated: MA discipline must hold even in hot sectors.
new_learnings.mechanism: Mean-reversion risk from extreme MA extension (>12% above MA20) dominates sector tailwind in the short term (5-10 day horizon).

new_learnings.text: RPS trajectory divergence pattern identified: 宏达电子 RPS20(97.21) > RPS60(92.82) > RPS120(92.19) = accelerating, but 10-day relative strength only 3.8% = recent weakness. This pattern needs outcome tracking to determine if it's a normal pullback or reversal signal.
new_learnings.mechanism: RPS measures cumulative relative return, so a stock that was very strong 20-60 days ago can still have high RPS20 even if the last 10 days are weak. This creates a lag effect that can mask emerging weakness.

new_learnings.text: Pullback to MA20 + fresh earnings catalyst (>100% growth) may be a repeatable entry pattern. 奥来德 at dist_ma20 +2.0% with 5-day-old +500% beat mirrors best setups from V1 backtesting. Track 10-day forward return.
new_learnings.mechanism: Fresh catalyst provides fundamental re-rating urgency while MA20 proximity provides technical support, creating an asymmetric risk/reward setup.
